==Description==
'''Ramiel''' was one of the seven narrators that appeared in [[Blind Faith]] as part of the [[Null & Void Event]]. He is one of the [[Children of Exo]].

==Appearance==
'''Ramiel''' had tan skin and black hair. He wore brown clothes, grey metal helmet, grey vest and grey shoes. Around his waist, he had a few small white plates hanging from. On his torso, there were a few chains, one of which had a giant sign with "''EXO''" written on it in purple. He had two metal shields on both of his arms.
